findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery (2025-11-15)
findings.quote: Conservative management must include a combination of strategies to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and correct underlying dysfunction, including physical therapy AND at least ONE complementary conservative treatment strategy.
findings.note: HCSC has no in-house TKA policy; per 2025 BCBSIL Commercial PA Summary, 'Musculoskeletal - Joint, Spine Surgery' is managed by Carelon. Carelon's Joint Surgery guideline (public, fetched) contains the operative TKA criteria.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery (2025-11-15)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 12 weeks of non-surgical conservative management
findings.note: Joint surgery PA delegated to Carelon (per 2025 BCBSIL Commercial PA Summary); Carelon guideline fetched, THA section confirmed.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery (2025-11-15)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management
findings.note: Rotator cuff repair (chronic/degenerative) section in Carelon Joint Surgery guideline; MSK surgery PA delegated to Carelon.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery (2025-11-15)
findings.quote: Failure of conservative management of at least 6 weeks' duration
findings.note: Total shoulder arthroplasty section in Carelon Joint Surgery guideline; HCSC's own SUR705.032 covers shoulder resurfacing only.

CPT 29888 not on BCBSIL 2025 commercial PA code list, no HCSC medical policy, and Carelon Joint Surgery guideline explicitly does NOT include ACL reconstruction. No public medical-necessity criteria located.

findings.title: Lumbar Spinal Fusion (SUR712.036)
findings.quote: Neurogenic claudication or radicular pain that results in significant functional impairment in an individual who has failed a minimum of 6 weeks of conservative care
findings.note: HCSC's own medical policy PDF (shared across BCBS IL/TX/NM/OK/MT); fetched and criteria confirmed. Carelon also administers spine surgery PA for FI/ASO accounts.

findings.title: Cervical Spinal Fusion (SUR712.041)
findings.quote: Unremitting radicular pain which has not responded to at least 6 weeks of appropriate conservative management
findings.note: HCSC medical policy PDF; CPT 22551 listed in the policy. Fetched and criteria confirmed.

findings.title: Total Ankle Replacement (TAR) (SUR705.021)
findings.quote: Failure of conservative treatment (i.e., anti-inflammatory medications, orthotic devices, activity modification, physical therapy) for a minimum of 6 months
findings.note: HCSC medical policy PDF; mapped to CPT 27702/27703 on BCBSIL medical policy reference list. Fetched and criteria confirmed.
No HCSC medical policy for bunionectomy/hallux valgus on the medical policy reference list; CPT 28296 not on the 2025 commercial PA code list; not in Carelon MSK scope. No public criteria located.

findings.title: Surgical Treatment of Femoroacetabular Impingement (SUR705.029)
findings.quote: Unresponsive to conservative therapy for at least 3 months (e.g., nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [NSAIDs], physical therapy, activity modifications
findings.note: HCSC medical policy PDF, mapped to CPT 29914-29916; fetched and criteria confirmed. Prior version (eff. 08/15/2024) also public at ...SUR705.029_2024-08-15.pdf.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Spine Surgery (2025-11-15, updated 2026-01-01)
findings.quote: Radicular pain (radiculitis/radiculopathy) with significant functional impairment or physical exam findings that correlate with radiculopathy or nerve root compression
findings.note: No HCSC in-house discectomy policy; spine surgery PA delegated to Carelon (2025 BCBSIL Commercial PA Summary). Criterion from 'Lumbar Discectomy, Foraminotomy, and Laminotomy' section.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Extremities (2025-11-15)
findings.quote: Failure of at least 4 weeks of conservative management
findings.note: BCBSIL 2025 commercial PA code list shows 73721/73221/72148 as Advanced Imaging 'Managed by Carelon for FI and ASO Accounts'. Quote is from the knee ligament-tear MRI indication; shoulder MRI also covered; lumbar spine MRI (72148) criteria are in Carelon's companion 'Imaging of the Spine' guideline on the same public site.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-311: Knee Replacement/Arthroplasty (V2.0.2025)
findings.quote: Failure of provider-directed non-surgical management for at least three (3) months duration
findings.note: Highmark Commercial delegates Musculoskeletal Surgery PA to eviCore (per Highmark medical policy portal 'eviCore Clinical Guidelines' page and eviCore Highmark QRG 2026-08); this public eviCore guideline contains the operative criteria. Highmark publishes no in-house TKA policy.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-313: Hip Replacement/Arthroplasty (V2.0.2025)
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; guideline fetched. Criterion applies with function-limiting pain for at least three months and documented failure of non-surgical management.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-315: Shoulder Surgery-Arthroscopic and Open Procedures (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: MRI or CT shows EITHER of the following findings: Grade 2 or 3 partial-thickness rotator cuff tear (Ellman classification)
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; CPT 29827 explicitly listed in guideline. Fetched and criteria confirmed.

findings.title: Highmark Medical Policy - eviCore Clinical Guidelines
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; criteria are eviCore CMM-318 Shoulder Arthroplasty/Replacement. Only Cigna-branded copies of CMM-318 are indexed publicly; the generic eviCore PDF URL could not be located (accessible via evicore.com guideline portal by plan selection). Tool: eviCore CMM-318.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-312: Knee Surgery-Arthroscopic and Open Procedures (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: MRI, CT arthrogram, or arthroscopy shows a tear/disruption or significant laxity of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL)
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; guideline has 'Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Reconstruction and Repair' section. Fetched and confirmed.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following for at least three (3) consecutive months (unless contraindicated): Prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs
findings.note: Highmark spine surgery PA delegated to eviCore (Highmark QRG 2026-08); guideline fetched and criteria confirmed.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: Subjective symptoms include BOTH of the following: Significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; ACDF-specific guideline fetched and criteria confirmed.

Total ankle replacement is not among eviCore's CMM joint-surgery guidelines for Highmark, and no Highmark commercial medical policy for ankle arthroplasty was located on securecms.highmark.com. No public criteria found.
Highmark Medicare Advantage draft policy Z-129-004 (bunionectomy) exists on securecms.highmark.com, but no Commercial bunionectomy/hallux valgus policy was located; not in eviCore MSK guideline set.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-314: Hip Surgery-Arthroscopic and Open Procedures (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: Femoroacetabular impingement confirmed on X-ray, MRI, or CT with ANY of the following findings: Alpha angle greater than 50 degrees
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; guideline fetched and FAI criteria confirmed.

findings.title: EviCore CMM-606: Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy) (V1.0.2025)
findings.quote: Significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)
findings.note: Delegated to eviCore; guideline fetched and criteria confirmed. Related public guideline: EviCore CMM-608 Lumbar Decompression.

findings.title: Highmark Medical Policy - eviCore Clinical Guidelines / Advanced Imaging transition notice
findings.note: Highmark medical policy portal states 'Advanced Imaging and Cardiology services will be managed by Highmark starting 12/1/2025' (previously eviCore radiology; eviCore Musculoskeletal Imaging Guidelines were the public criteria). Highmark's current in-house advanced-imaging criteria were not found published publicly. Tool: Highmark in-house UM (formerly eviCore imaging guidelines).
